summary: security checked in 4 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed for the managed fleet and blocked for SearchWoot public exposure. Fleet-doctor has no run or checks; operations has no deploy, uptime, or error sweeps. Authentication, access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, monitoring, incident response, TLS completeness, and disclosure readiness therefore remain unknown. No certificate is reported expiring within 30 days, but that is not full TLS validation. Compliance records 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. Operational risk signals include 41 failed implementation requests, 46 open repair items, and 69 retained executive tick failures; these do not prove compromise. Recommend bounded read-only evidence capture, no credentials or private-container access, no exploitation, no permission changes, and no production mutation. Ordinary reversible growth is not blocked solely by optional hardening or incomplete telemetry when it adds no new data use and preserves existing controls.

Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private. Public exposure remains blocked until access, secret, isolation, release, dependency, monitoring, incident, TLS, data-exposure, and disclosure evidence is complete, alongside the existing rights, privacy, accuracy, measurement, and owner gates. This is a security risk disposition, not certification or a clean bill of health.

items.title: Maintain evidence-needed fleet security disposition
items.summary: Complete one bounded read-only security evidence matrix for authentication and access boundaries, secrets exposure, container isolation, release and deploy controls, TLS, dependency and supply-chain risk, data exposure, incident signals, monitoring, and disclosure readiness. Preserve unknowns where fleet-doctor or operations evidence is unavailable.
items.requested_action: Use authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Record evidence timestamps, owners, affected scope, exact unknowns, severity, and release implications. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, change permissions, modify production, deploy, or request duplicate telemetry.

items.title: Maintain SearchWoot private security gate
items.summary: Keep SearchWoot private while security and release evidence remains incomplete, without expanding alerts, changing credentials or configuration, deploying, or sending external requests.
items.requested_action: Permit only bounded read-only evidence work and internal draft preparation. Complete the access, secret, isolation, release, TLS, dependency, monitoring, incident, data-exposure, and disclosure checklist before reconsidering public exposure.
